frictions.description: Chrome DevTools MCP profile lock (`chrome-profile already in use`) prevented attaching to the browser surface for all assigned UI assertions.
frictions.resolution: Not resolved within non-disruptive boundaries; did not kill browser/processes per mission constraints.

blockers.description: Browser automation surface unavailable due to shared Chrome profile lock.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried `list_pages`; retried `new_page` including isolated context; validated local service reachability with curl.

summary: Assigned rerun set could not be executed on the real browser surface because Chrome DevTools MCP remained locked by an in-use profile; all 20 assigned assertions were marked blocked, including VAL-MAP3D-017 which is additionally out-of-scope for browser-only rerun (shell lint assertion).
